title: Teldrassil
body: Teldrassil, crown of the earth, is the second World Tree of the night elves, rising from the Veiled Sea off the northern coast of Kalimdor. After the Battle of Mount Hyjal left Nordrassil scarred and the kaldorei mortal, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew it, hoping to win their immortality back. Its boughs hold a whole land of hills, lakes and forest, with Darnassus in the west. Yet its growth has proved flawed: fel cones drop from its branches, the gentle furbolgs have turned savage and the timberlings sicken.

parts.body: Once the tree was grown, Staghelm sought the dragons' blessing, as they had blessed Nordrassil of old. Nozdormu refused him and chided his arrogance, Alexstrasza refused as well, and Teldrassil has grown flawed ever since.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Teldrassil (name meaning, grown by Fandral after the Legion's invasion, Veiled Sea, forested upper reaches, Darnassus in the west)

parts.body: For a time the Scourge reaches even the World Tree: spectral spirits and skeletal troopers gather before the gates of Darnassus beneath a necropolis.

title: Shadowglen
body: Ringed by mountains in the northeast of Teldrassil, Shadowglen is a twilit glade where young night elves first take up blade, bow and staff under mentors who live inside Aldrassil, a great tree within the World Tree. Tenaron Stormgrip, who leads the glade, holds that none should leave without learning their people's recent history, and even here the tree's troubles show: grells creep through the woods, tainted by fel moss.

title: Dolanaar
body: Dolanaar is the first true town on the road south from Shadowglen, a night elf village gathered about a moonwell, where Corithras Moonrage tells the young how their people came to their new home, one chapter for every phial of moonwell water they bring him. The troubles of the forest are weighed here too, and they come close: just to the north, in the cave of Fel Rock, a satyr lord has gathered a band of grells.

parts.body: His chapters tell of a people adrift. After Hyjal the night elves lost their immortality, the Betrayer was freed, Malfurion Stormrage vanished, and Fandral Staghelm took up the leadership of the druids.

title: Ban'ethil Barrow Den
body: Below the road to Darnassus, in Ban'ethil Hollow, lies the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, a sacred place built to shelter the Druids of the Talon while they sleep, their spirits walking the Emerald Dream under a pact with Ysera, and a Great Warden keeps watch over their slumber. The maddened Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun the hollow and ransacked the den.

parts.body: The Gnarlpine shamans have learned to part a sleeping druid's spirit from his body: Oben Rageclaw's spirit wanders the barrow, powerless, while his own animated form guards its depths.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ban'ethil_Barrow_Den (sacred place built to hold sleeping Druids of the Talon, Gnarlpine took control)

title: Lake Al'Ameth
body: South of Dolanaar spreads Lake Al'Ameth, one of the largest lakes on Teldrassil, and to the northeast lies Wellspring Lake. Their shores have grown unsafe, for the timberlings, elementals of nature that mirror the health of the tree's plants and beasts, have turned angry and sprout mossy tumors. The herbalist Denalan camps on the eastern shore, searching for a cure.

parts.body: In a cave on the lake's southern bank lurks the timberling Oakenscowl, once a grand leader of his kind, poisoned by a gargantuan tumor and spreading corruption to every creature of the lake.

title: The Oracle Glade
body: In the northwest of Teldrassil stands the Oracle Tree, an ancient and wise presence that watches over the World Tree's growth and sends its reports to the Arch Druid on shed pieces of bark. Beneath it lies the first and most powerful moonwell on the island. Bloodfeather harpies have nested all around the glade, and on a branch at its edge dwells the reclusive satyr Sethir the Ancient.

parts.body: Freed of the harpies, the Oracle Tree sent its report to Darnassus at last. Some of Teldrassil's problems are lessened, Fandral found, while others grow into greater concerns.

title: Rut'theran Village
body: Rut'theran Village sits among the roots of Teldrassil on the shore of the Veiled Sea, the island's link to the mainland. A portal carries travelers up to Darnassus, a ferry sails to Auberdine in Darkshore, and hippogryphs fly constantly to the far shore. The waters here are astonishingly rich: fish caught off Teldrassil grow to nearly twice the size of their mainland kin, thanks, the villagers suspect, to the swift growth of the World Tree.
